headline: UBS expects the S&P 500 to reach 8,400 by June as AI spending and earnings keep the rally going.
score_reason: A bank's index forecast with stated doubts; pool score 5 kept.
importance_line: It matters most to people whose savings are in US stock funds, though the target depends on earnings outrunning higher interest rates and oil prices, and Fed minutes released the same day point to another rate hike by year-end.
summary: investingLive reports that the Swiss bank UBS expects the S&P 500 index to reach 8,400 by June next year, arguing that AI investment and strong earnings can carry the market through rising interest rates. UBS forecasts S&P 500 earnings to rise 25% this year and 14% in 2027, and it warns that volatility is likely while Treasury yields are at multi-decade highs.
notes: Read in full on investingLive. The UBS note was published before the Wednesday 7 Oct US session. The Fed minutes and the Axios report are cited in the article, not checked separately.
